title: [PM seat] repo:objectstack · seat 3 — 🟢 os-support-ai · 由 os-support-ai 账户的项目负责 · area:workflow (p1/p2)
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** This post is the seat, **`repo:objectstack` seat 3** (the whole-repo lane). Only what another account must read lives here.
- Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` and `references/area-lease.md` (⛔ not copied here).
- Previous tenure (epic #34571, session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG) ended with the hand-off 6968205670 + 6968248888 to repo:objectstack#1; its body is the previous revision of this post.

## Current PM — 🟢 os-support-ai

- **Holder:** `os-support-ai` · `session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W`, re-seated 2026-11-23T10:24Z on the maintainer's summons in the os-support-ai fleet project, verbatim: 「加载最新的 pm-dispatch 技能，开一个 objectstack 座位」「处理 area:workflow」「只处理 p1 p2 任务」. The project's account is responsible for this seat.
- **Intake:** open `area:workflow` cards graded `priority:p1` or `priority:p2` only (p3 and ungraded are not taken). At most 5 running card threads or dev subagents; a PR that only waits on an approval does not count. Excluded: cloud cards (`repo:cloud` seats), security advisories, other repositories, and cards another seat already claimed.
- **Mailbox:** PR #36664 (subscribed). **Patrol:** `trig_01GhWfgJC5pjyK6VZ5aLTjCE` · `23 * * * *` (hourly, self-bound).
- **Posture ledger lives in the project:** labels, assignee, `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: repo:objectstack#3`, and the `head:claude/` PRs.

## Leases

- No areas at seating: 12 claimable p1/p2 `area:workflow` cards, under the 15-card partition threshold (`area-lease.md`); cards are claimed one by one. Clusters, for overlap reading only: approvals (`plugin-approvals`, console approvals inbox), messaging/Slack (`service-messaging`, `connector-slack`), print (`service-print`), sync-in engine, working-calendar formulas.

## Hot-file serial queue

- None at seating.

## Notes

- Write path: the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
- Contract (L2) reviews go to the online review seats by mailbox (`Request: contract-review`) or an isolated contract-review-tier subagent.
- Publication: objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
